title: The Fire of God and the Three Youths
english: Does he remember? In order to show that God opposes the proud and gives grace to the humble, He burned the arrogant outside the furnace, but preserved those who are humble in the midst of the fire. Therefore also the fire continued with the saints; for even among all things, the Creator was commanded to praise even the fire: 'Bless, fire and burning, the Lord' (Ps 148:8). This is so that the Babylonian magicians, by whom fire is honored, might be instructed, because this [fire] is not of those being worshiped, but of those worshiping. But nevertheless, coming to the last part, let us rest the word. 'Bless, says Ananias, Azarias, Mishael, the Lord' (Dan 3:24). What was the need for so many ranks to be listed before their final name? For were they not themselves among the sons of Israel blessing?
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Purpose of the Blessing
english: They were not included among the slaves of the Lord when they were saying, 'Bless, slaves of the Lord, the Lord'; nor, when [they were called] 'Holy and humble in heart,' were they counted among the holy ones. So what is the purpose of the deposition, 'Bless, Hananiah, Azariah, Mishael, the Lord'? But because the wonder was superabundant, because it was against human nature (for having entered the furnace in body, they trod upon it), so that no one of the fallen might dare to call them gods because of the strange wonder, and so that they might worship more justly, rather than the fire [consuming] those surrounded by the fire, so that those seeing might not suffer such a thing; for this reason they signal their own slavery and confess the worship, saying, 'Bless, Hananiah, Azariah, Mishael, the Lord.' And it is said that God did not allow Daniel to continue into the...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Integrity of the Miracle
english: This testimony was received. For since the king's dream was interpreted, and he was worshiped by this king as a god, and he was called Belteshazzar by the name of the god among the Persians (Dan 5:13), so that it might not be thought—because of the name of Belteshazzar being attached to him—that the fire's energy had ceased, God manages that Daniel not be brought into the middle, so that the wonder might be pure in its piety. And these things indeed are to this much; but may it be for us, through the prayers and intercessions of those who bore witness, to take up the same zeal, to be worthy of the same praises, and to obtain the same kingdom, by the grace and philanthropy of our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom the glory and the power belong unto the ages of ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
